rejectedLegacyRuntimePolicy.reason: Existing runtime carriers predate the AGC visual bar. They remain mounted only as explicit replacement targets and must never count as reviewed art.

lifecycleStateContract.completionRule: Only INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED plus an approved style review and independent browser evidence may count as completed.

scope.truthfulStatus: This ledger proves mounted runtime identity/action wiring only. It does not approve the current protagonist, enemy, card or UI art direction; Batch B/C identity candidates and Batch D/E action candidates remain pending independently attested visual completion.

incrementalScopes.truthfulStatus: This Batch G sidecar records one mounted Boss phase-transition FX sequence and one dedicated battlefield. Their runtime reachability may be validated, but their visual style remains pending independent review.
These three generated carriers are mounted candidates for spell, pill and body attack contact semantics. Runtime reachability does not constitute final visual approval.

These generated carriers visualize only resolver-confirmed mixed-target effects. They are mounted candidates, remain presentation-only, and are not final art until browser and independent visual review pass.
L1/H1 generated carriers and battlefields are mounted candidates with authored proportions and provenance. Browser and independent visual approval remain required.
Body/Pill generated world assets are mounted candidates with authored non-uniform proportions; browser and independent visual review remain required.
K2 assets are generated, processed and runtime-mounted candidates. Browser and independent visual review remain required; finalArtApproved stays false.
Generated and runtime-mounted attack candidates for S2 spell/body/pill; browser and independent visual review remain required; finalArtApproved stays false.
Generated and runtime-mounted S2 spell/body/pill skill candidates with source-local VFX; browser and independent review remain required; finalArtApproved stays false.
Generated and runtime-mounted S2 route-specific guard/reaction candidates with compact source-local defensive VFX; browser and independent review remain required; finalArtApproved stays false.
Generated and runtime-mounted S2 route-specific actual-damage hurt candidates; browser and independent review remain required; finalArtApproved stays false.
Six S2 route terminal candidates are runtime-mounted and browser-verified; independent product-visual and strict counter-audits passed P0/P1/P2=0. Final art approval remains false.

N1 golden thunder/furnace assets are generated, processed and runtime-mounted with entity-specific authored proportions. Browser composite and independent adversarial visual review remain required; finalArtApproved stays false.
Three causal enemy-to-player travel candidates and one furnace-flame terminal residue sequence are runtime-mounted. Browser composite and independent review remain required.
N8 candidates are runtime-mounted and browser-verified; independent internal strict/visual agents passed, but no external attestation or user final-art approval exists; finalArtApproved stays false.
N9 generated candidates are runtime-mounted and browser-verified; independent internal visual audit passed, while final art approval remains false.
N11 generated candidates are runtime-mounted and browser-verified; independent internal strict and visual audits passed with P0/P1=0, while final art approval remains false.
S4/S5 four-route seven-family action candidates and S2 sword victory are generated and runtime-mounted; independent visual audit remains pending and finalArtApproved stays false.

N13 deterministic candidates are runtime-mounted, the public-entry desktop/narrow family representative is browser-verified, and the independent strict audit is verified; final art approval remains false.

N14 deterministic candidates are runtime-mounted, the public-entry desktop/narrow family representative is browser-verified, and the independent strict audit is verified; final art approval remains false.
Six formerly uncovered reachable guard/observe actions are runtime-mounted, public-entry browser-verified and independently strict-audited; final art approval remains false.

N12 identity/action media, spatial metrics, actor-free battlefields, ten encounter-owned plan graphs and twenty dedicated mechanism VFX families are mounted. Representative desktop/narrow spatial and mechanism/VFX browser acceptance is verified; final art approval remains false.
